اسحنككن (form XIV)
# اِسْحَنْكَكْنَ (isḥankakna) /is.ħan.kak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# اِسْحَنْكِكْنَ (isḥankikna) /is.ħan.kik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
